bullets.text: In Gummidipoondi near Elavur, a worker named N Santhosh died and two others fell critical after exposure to triphosgene gas while shifting containers; the office must monitor safety compliance.
In Ambattur, sudden heavy rain flooded the industrial estate and surrounding areas with water logging, prompting the corporation to deploy 32 tractors for relief and monitoring.
In Chennai, heavy rain caused severe waterlogging in neighborhoods like Thirverkadu, Ambattur, and Poonamallee within a short span, requiring the office to coordinate civic drainage responses.

The Pallikaranai wetland buffer zone was reduced to an interim 316.76 acres after wetland authority reviews, while petitions and political protests continue against the state government over boundary reductions.
In Thiruvanmiyur near Velachery, police arrested an auto driver who used obscene language against a college student at a bus stop, highlighting local public safety concerns.
In Velachery and across Chennai, motorists driving on the wrong side continue to pose risks to pedestrians, indicating a need for strict traffic enforcement by authorities.
At the North Chennai Thermal Power Station in Ponneri, workers staged a protest demonstration demanding the withdrawal of the smart meter scheme, which the office should monitor.
The NGT southern bench directed Avadi Corporation to implement an action plan preventing solid waste and contaminants from polluting the Cooum river, requiring strict municipal follow-up.
In Ayyappakkam, residents faced a six-month drinking water shortage due to unauthorized private borewells depleting groundwater, prompting the office to address illegal extraction.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong jointly inaugurated a 46 MW data centre established by CapitaLand in Ambattur, Chennai.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay unveiled the Tamil Nadu Semiconductor Ecosystem Policy 2026 with customized investment incentives to position the state as India's premier hub.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi appreciated healthcare AI innovations developed by Chennai-incubated deep-tech startup MEDxAI Innovations, highlighting state tech achievements.
Greater Chennai Corporation Mayor R Priya criticised the TVK-led government for cancelling tenders worth at least 700 crore rupees for various city projects, accusing it of stalling works.
News reports highlighted public discussions regarding price rises, inflation, and essential commodities in Tamil Nadu, prompting political scrutiny that the office should track.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay laid the foundation stone for a ring main pipeline project costing 3,108.55 crore rupees to interlink water sources and ensure equitable drinking water supply.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi scheduled a visit to Chennai to inaugurate and dedicate the 14.5 km metro rail service between Poonamallee and Vadapalani.
